properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Lockfile-declared dependency (both sightings are yarn.lock entries): hash.js@1.1.3 ships SHA-1/SHA-2/RIPEMD-160 wrappers via the crypto-browserify/ethereumjs toolchain behind web3.js and ethers v5 browser builds. No direct application import found; reachable transitively. Changeable here via package.json resolutions.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Toolchain-shipped RSA: the library is genuinely declared — a direct dependency in package.json dependencies (line 642) plus a security pin in resolutions (line 610, ^1.0.0 = the CVE-2022-24784/24785-patched line). No RSA call site exists in the repo's 359 .ts files, so this is availability-in-the-build, not application use. Changeable here (edit package.json).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 signature capability available via tweetnacl@0.14.5, a transitive dependency of the hardhat/ethers toolchain resolved in yarn.lock. No tweetnacl import exists in the repo's .ts sources; the algorithm ships with the build and is available to any toolchain component. Changeable here via dependency upgrade.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECDH (secp256k1) available via elliptic@6.5.4, which is explicitly security-pinned in package.json resolutions (line 622) — the release that fixed ECDSA signature-forgery CVE-2020-13822. Transitive dependency of the ethers/web3/hardhat stack; no application call site. The pin itself is a governance artifact worth keeping visible in the inventory.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X25519 (scalarMult key agreement) available via the same transitive tweetnacl@0.14.5 locked in yarn.lock. No application call site in .ts sources; toolchain-shipped availability.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES implementation inside the same directly-declared node-forge dependency (package.json:642, resolutions pin at :610). No application call site in the .ts sources; ships with the toolchain. AES is symmetric and PQ-tolerant at adequate key sizes — the asset is library availability.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt via scrypt-js@2.0.4, transitive in yarn.lock (Ethereum keystore/BIP39 derivation path of the toolchain). No application call site in .ts sources; toolchain-shipped availability.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: XSalsa20-Poly1305 (nacl secretbox/box authenticated encryption) available via transitive tweetnacl@0.14.5 in yarn.lock. No application call site. Symmetric AE is PQ-tolerant, but note the library version dates from 2017.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Both sites are the same declaration viewed twice: the '.' site is the collector's root-level aggregate, 'package.json' is the manifest line. node-forge is a direct dependency (package.json:642) and a resolutions security pin (package.json:610) — the pin exists to force the patched 1.x line through the toolchain tree. This is the dependency-inventory entry for the crypto library.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X.509 certificate/TLS machinery in the directly-declared node-forge dependency (RSA-based PKI by default). No application call site found; ships in the toolchain dependency tree.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl@0.14.5 (released 2017) is locked in yarn.lock as a transitive dependency of the hardhat/ethers toolchain. This is the dependency-inventory entry for the library; no direct import in application sources.
